basic_info.description: Exceptional home with great elegance and style, flooded with light in a fantastic neighborhood, close to Laurel Village, shops and restaurants. Private courtyard. Fantastic public rooms surrounded by gardens. 4 bedrooms, including luxurious Master Bedroom that is a serene retreat. Separate Guest Suite or office. Parking, laundry, storage, three fireplaces, cedar lined closets, sound system, many amenities.
